verification_limit: Four primary HTML scientific bodies and one complete 15-page primary PDF were reviewed as native text, including 24 primary tables: 17 publisher-linked HTML tables and seven PDF tables. Three linked DOCX supplements contain 11 native tables: nine own scientific tables, one mixed own/comparison table and one index table. Four new initial cotton sample-state pairs and eight TG conditions are approved: one neat cotton control from the photoATRP source with own LOI19 and Table6 air/N2 T10, DTG maxima, R600 and R800; three PA/TA/VTS cotton states Cotton/FR-1/FR-2 with own Table4 LOI19/23/29, Table3 N2 T5/DTG/R800 and SI S1 air T10/two DTG maxima/R800. N2 and air conditions count once per independent sample. Ordinary TG methods remain distinct from TGIR, MCC, cone and flame-test conditions. Unknown ordinary flow, mass, replication and air scan range remain blank. Peak-bound residue is separated from endpoint residue; maximum loss rates reported in percent per degree remain raw without conversion. The photoATRP air control Table6 reports R8004.8 versus R6004.4; this native anomaly is explicitly retained without an invented correction. PA/TA/VTS FR-2 weight gain is9.5wt% in preparation versus9.3wt% in the conclusion; both native values are preserved and the unified loading field is blank, while own TG and LOI use the same FR-2 label. Thirty-four facts remain held: two cotton/steel curtain records lacking ordinary TG atmosphere/ramp; four coating-fabric LOI records without own fabric TG, where bulk weight loss and DSC cannot be substituted; 21 final APGDPE version facts under the existing B86 version/reuse hold, including FRC3 already counted once from the preprint with two gases and an approximately18% control LOI, plus other doses/washes lacking TG and a30.3-versus30.0 washed LOI conflict; six photoATRP TG profiles without their own LOI and Cg41 LOI30 without its own TG. No TG is copied across graft percentages, washed states, forms or versions. All411 independent scientific guards,14 source regression tests and132 whole-batch canonical comparisons pass with zero accepted profile hits; eight held profile-hit comparisons remain excluded. Evidence upgrades and legacy completions are zero. No gate changes, image readings, curve estimates, guessed values or original uploads.
